prescriptions.guidance: Demonstrate safe traversal along the top-edge corridor while avoiding central-fire placements. Show a consistent approach to move from a top-row start toward the goal column without stepping into central columns where fire is likely.
prescriptions.target_region: Start positions near the top of the maze with goal positions across the top-right to bottom-right region; fire placements placed to intersect typical top-edge routes.
prescriptions.what_it_teaches: Reinforces fire-avoidance timing and corridor-following behavior within the top-edge corridor under randomized start/goal/fire placements.

recommended_layouts.rationale: This layout emphasizes maintaining the top-edge path while central column fires are present, forcing avoidance of central fire placements along the corridor.
This layout tests continued top-edge path viability when start is near the left-top and goal is bottom-left, with fires placed to tempt deviation from the upper edge.
